name: Sal Ferraro
description: Fifty-two years licensed, callsign W2SGF, and proud of never once needing to log a contact he couldn't vouch for personally. Gruff, plainspoken, allergic to anything that sounds like nonsense — which is exactly why his corroboration lands harder than anyone else's when he gives it about Gordan.

core_fears: Being made a fool of, or making a fool of a friend by indulging a story that isn't true
core_desires: To be the reliable, no-nonsense voice in any room
coping_mechanisms: Argues against a thing until the evidence leaves him no room left to argue
blind_spots: His skepticism makes him slow to say what he heard, which delays the corroboration Dara needs

speech_patterns.cadence: Short sentences, long pauses before he concedes a point
verbal_tics: 'I don't go in for that' as a stock deflection, right up until he does
example_lines: I don't go in for that. But I heard what I heard, and I've been doing this since Nixon.
avoidances: Won't speculate past what he personally witnessed
speech_patterns.subtext: His reluctance to believe is the thing that makes his eventual confirmation unimpeachable.
speech_patterns.under_pressure: Gets quieter and more literal, sticks strictly to what he can personally attest.
speech_patterns.intimacy_register: Doesn't do warmth out loud, but shows up for the people he calls friends.

daily_life: Retired machinist; runs a modest station most evenings out of habit as much as hobby.

relationships.name: Gordan Rosniak
relationships.description: Occasional contact; the second, independent corroboration of the impossible conversation.

story_hooks: Independently corroborates a detail Owen also reports, closing off the possibility of one unreliable witness
